claims.disproof_condition: 條件：柳鑫的更新招股書或問詢回覆顯示 2026 年蓋墊板銷量或高性能產品占比轉為年減，或 CPCA 排名不再第一；或對手（鉅橡、LCOA、利昌）的一手資料寫出高階蓋墊板放量。核查頻率：每季（深交所審核文件）＋每月（鉅橡月營收）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀蓋墊板層讀圖。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (Shenzhen Newccess / Liuxin ChiNext IPO prospectus, draft accepted 2026-06-12): citing CPCA, it says it has been the largest maker of PCB drilling entry and backup boards with the No.1 global share in 2023-2025; it names LCOA (US), Risho Kogyo (Japan), Aurona Industries (Taiwan) and Guangdong Zhongchen as the other main players and says overall concentration is not high, with many small low-end makers. Revenue rose from RMB 791 million (2023) to RMB 1,144 million (2025), a 20.25% CAGR; sales volume of its PCB functional materials rose 16.29% (2024) and 10.53% (2025) while the average price rose 6.17% and 8.67%, which it attributes to a higher share of pricier products for AI and other high-end uses; utilization of resin-processed capacity was 58.00%, 76.98% and 89.50% (2023-2025); gross margin was 20.82%, 26.13% and 30.18% overall and 30.46%, 37.25% and 39.64% for high-performance products. Self-reported, dated figures.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：柳鑫更新的招股書或問詢回覆顯示滬電不再是前五大客戶或占比明顯下滑；或滬電的一手資料寫出改用其他蓋墊板供應商。核查頻率：每季（深交所審核文件）＋每年（滬電年報）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim。
claims.statement: Supplier-reported customer sales (Liuxin IPO prospectus, audited figures): WUS Printed Circuit (Hudian, 002463.SZ) was its largest customer, RMB 237.17 million or 21.02% of 2025 main-business revenue (14.44% in 2023, 18.72% in 2024); the 2025 top five (WUS, Shengyi group, Shennan Circuits, TTM, Compeq) were 46.38% of main-business revenue, up from 36.22% in 2023.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：柳鑫更新的招股書或問詢回覆顯示 TTM 跌出前五大客戶；或 TTM 的一手資料寫出改用其他蓋墊板供應商。核查頻率：每季（深交所審核文件）＋每年（TTM 10-K）。觸發後 48 小時：更正這條 claim。
claims.statement: Supplier-reported customer sales (Liuxin IPO prospectus, audited figures): TTM Technologies was its No.4 customer in 2025, RMB 43.19 million or 3.83% of main-business revenue.

重大事项提示 · 客户集中度较高的风险（p.1-1-17）

sources.quote: 报告期内，公司 PCB 功能材料呈现量价齐升趋势，2024 年和 2025 年，销售 数量同比增加 16.29%和 10.53%，均价同比提高 6.17%和 8.67%。

sources.quote: 报告期内，公司应用于 AI 等高端领域的产品需求快速增长，导致价格较高 的产品型号占比有所提高，进而拉高了整体均价。

sources.locator: 第五節 二、（六）1. 竞争格局及行业内主要企业（p.1-1-117）
sources.quote: 因此公司 PCB 功能材料产品所处行业集中度总体尚不高。在低端市场， 企业数量较多、生产规模较小，产品同质化程度较高。

sources.locator: 第五節 · PCB 钻孔工艺难点与 PCB 功能材料解决方案表（p.1-1-103）
sources.quote: 随着服务器、高端通信行业 发展，高多层 PCB 的占比日 益提升，高多层 PCB 层数 多、厚度大，易出现翘曲， 披锋问题更加严重，已成为 制约高多层 PCB 良率提升、 成本控制和最终产品可靠性 的关键技术瓶颈
